property_summary: For any inputs, run(...) ensures that transfer either returns true without reverting and all external calls to caddress succeeded, or it reverted — i.e., a successful transfer never reports success while any internal call failed.
If c.transfer does not revert, it must return true.
For any non-empty _tos with matching lengths, calling transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., it cannot return false) when array lengths match and >0.
When _tos is non-empty and lengths match, C.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false) — expressed so the assert only checks that if call did not revert then it returned true.
